title: OpsIQ Capability Matrix — evidence-grounded truth assessment
method: Hostile, evidence-first. Each module is assessed against actual source + tests + the required CI lane (LANE_B in .github/workflows/db-verification.yml) + audit dirs — never memory. Where proof is weaker than the capability's ambition, the weaker truth is recorded.

classificationLegend.PROVEN_CI_REQUIRED: Unit tests + a same-name DB simulation that runs in the REQUIRED LANE_B on every PR (verified by log inspection).
classificationLegend.PROVEN_CI_RELATED: Unit tests + DB proof that runs in LANE_B, but only under a differently-named end-to-end/coherence/proof file (name-level traceability is weaker).
classificationLegend.PROVEN_DB_NOT_IN_CI: Unit tests + a DB simulation that exists on disk but is NOT wired into the required LANE_B lane — so it is not gated on every PR.
classificationLegend.PROVEN_UNIT_ONLY: Deterministic unit tests (often adversarial) but NO DB-backed proof anywhere.
classificationLegend.BACKEND_ONLY: Dimension flag: proven in backend/CI but NOT surfaced in an owner-visible UI.

globalTruths: OpsIQ decisions are DETERMINISTIC rule engines. There is no live LLM/AI write-path: src/services/ai/openai-provider.ts has no importers and self-reports 'live AI disabled, deterministic path used'.

OpsIQ takes NO autonomous external action (no customer contact, tender submit, spend, discount, contract). autonomy-policy + capability-registry enforce autonomous_action_prohibited / external_action_prohibited.
OpsIQ fabricates NO money/ROI/win-probability. Multiple schemas refine against money/percent/ROI text; enforced by tests.
Nearly all capabilities are BACKEND_ONLY: proven by tests + CI + audits, but not yet surfaced in an owner-visible UI. This is the most common honest gap.
There is NO verified real-world business outcome data. No claim that OpsIQ has saved/grown a real business is supported.

capabilities.capability: Interpret raw free-text public business signals into structured issues
capabilities.allowed: Deterministically turns messy free text into typed, evidence-tagged issues in tests + CI.
capabilities.forbidden: Understands any business like a human / uses AI comprehension.

capabilities.capability: Resolve contradictory signals without collapsing distinct issues
capabilities.allowed: Handles conflicting signals adversarially in tests + CI.
capabilities.forbidden: Always resolves conflicts correctly for any real business.

capabilities.capability: Prioritise many simultaneous signals by severity/evidence
capabilities.allowed: Deterministically orders high signal volume under stress in tests + CI.
capabilities.forbidden: Knows the single most important thing for a real owner.

capabilities.capability: Explain each prioritised decision coherently to the owner
capabilities.allowed: Produces coherent, non-contradictory decision explanations in tests + CI.
capabilities.forbidden: Explanations are validated against real owner comprehension.

capabilities.capability: Survival-first crisis navigation with honest unrecoverable handling
capabilities.allowed: Ranks survival above growth and refuses to fake optimism when unrecoverable, in tests + CI.
capabilities.forbidden: Guarantees a business will survive or recover.

capabilities.capability: Drive recovery through evidence-gated milestones over cycles
capabilities.allowed: Advances milestones only on evidence + passing reassessment; blocks skipping, premature growth, fake recovery — in tests + CI.

capabilities.capability: Route a detected bottleneck into governed corrections
capabilities.allowed: Turns the top breakdown into trackable, evidence+approval-gated corrections in tests + CI.

capabilities.forbidden: Executes tasks in the outside world.

capabilities.capability: Classify corrections into governed approval decisions
capabilities.allowed: Nothing auto-executes without the right approval, verified in CI.

capabilities.capability: Surface cash/profit risk with honest data gaps, no fabricated money

capabilities.forbidden: Reports a real cash runway or profit number.

capabilities.forbidden: Disciplines, fires, or manages payroll for staff.
